title: Read the manual first
story: ColabFold predicts protein structures with AlphaFold2. On Geiss-01 it comes from a module, and its command is `colabfold_batch`. Load the module and read its help to find out how many models it runs by default. Type the number in the answer box.

tasks.text: How many models does it use by default?

hints: `module load colabfold` puts `colabfold_batch` on your PATH.
Almost every program prints its options with `--help`: `colabfold_batch --help`.
Look for `--num-models` in the help. The default is in brackets.
